title: Timing, Entry, and Revenue in Clock-Based Platform Markets
abstract: arXiv:2604.10638v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On platforms where time-to-contract is itself payoff-relevant--Aalsmeer's flower auctions, ride-hailing dispatch, on-demand-labor matching--the textbook revenue equivalence between Dutch and first-price formats holds the trading outcome fixed. Once participation is endogenous and both sides bear waiting costs, the trading format directly shapes who enters, market thickness, volume, and platform revenue. The platform's ranking of the descending clock against immediate and batched posted-price benchmarks is decided by two estimable primitives on each side of the market: an earnings gap and a timing gap. A bidirectional four-case classification identifies when the descending clock dominates at every level of waiting costs, only above a floor, only below a ceiling, or not at all; the last case is unconditional -- when the descending clock charges no more per trade and contracts no faster than the posted-price benchmark, it cannot win. translated_title: 基于时钟机制平台市场中的时机、进入与收入
translated_abstract: 在成交时间本身影响收益的平台市场中——如阿斯米尔鲜花拍卖、网约车派单、按需用工匹配——教科书中荷兰式拍卖与一级价格拍卖之间的收入等价定理默认交易结果固定不变。一旦参与是内生的，且市场双方都承担等待成本，交易机制就会直接决定谁进入市场、市场厚度、交易量以及平台收入。平台对递减时钟拍卖相对于即时定价和批量定价基准的优劣排序，由市场双方各两个可估计的基本参数决定：收益差距和时机差距。一个双向的四情形分类法识别出递减时钟拍卖何时在所有等待成本水平上占优、仅在等待成本高于某个下限时占优、仅在低于某个上限时占优，或者完全不占优；最后一种情形是无条件的——当递减时钟拍卖的单笔交易收费不高于定价基准、且成交速度不快于定价基准时，它不可能胜出。
tldr: 该论文研究成交时间影响收益的平台市场，证明当参与内生且双方承担等待成本时，收入等价不再成立，递减时钟拍卖相对定价基准的优劣由市场双方可估计的“收益差距”与“时机差距”两个基本参数决定，并通过四情形分类刻画其何时占优。
en_tdlr: In platform markets where time-to-contract is payoff-relevant, endogenous participation and waiting costs break textbook revenue equivalence, and the descending clock's ranking against posted-price benchmarks is determined by two estimable primitives on each side of the market—an earnings gap and a timing gap—yielding a four-case classification of when it dominates.
